description: Reproducibility materials for the manuscript "Falsification tests of TMD-relative ribosome profiles identify topology-associated compartmental differences". Public software release v1.0.1 preserves scientific version 1.0.1-rc.2 and includes the frozen processed-input calculations, source tables, environments, S16/S13 within-gene/composition sensitivities, S17/S14 annotation-overlap exclusion and matched-population operational UMI-like collapse workflows, and documented historical runner provenance. The sensitivities are post-reveal and exploratory. This package does not establish independent biological replication, validated molecular-UMI deduplication, comparable footprint-length sensitivity or complete raw-read-to-result reproduction. The exact Ensembl release 104 GTF is an external dependency for optional annotation regeneration; density-level replay uses included processed inputs. MIT applies only to software identified as MIT in Code_for_Review/FILE_LEVEL_CODE_LICENSE_MANIFEST.tsv, including documented author-owned code and inherited TMD-RiboSeq and PyYAML components with their original notices. The identified plastid-derived component retains BSD-3-Clause. These licenses apply to their respective components, not as alternative licenses for the complete archive. Data, annotations, processed intermediates and scientific outputs retain applicable source terms; no blanket MIT license or additional data reuse permission is granted. Where source records specify no additional reuse license, none is asserted here. Consult COMPONENT_RIGHTS.md, Code_for_Review/LICENSE_SCOPE.md, the file-level manifest and preserved third-party notices.
